content:
A 2nd-semester exam project by a team of 3 at EK Lyngby, making a better solution for Johannes Fog’s custom carport order process. Tajan92/Carport-Fog Java 1 0 Java & MVC Backend Built using robust Java Object-Oriented paradigms following the Model-View-Controller architecture for high maintainability. Database & Deployment Relational PostgreSQL database for data storage, deployed and hosted live on a Digital Ocean. Frontend & SVG Rendering Clean HTML, CSS, and JavaScript creating dynamic SVG vector graphics directly scaled to customer dimensions. Collabrative Project We built the project on a solid foundation of analyzes in form of user stories, a domain model, ERD diagram, risk assesment, class diagram, figma all over good discustions to deliver a good software arcitecture and evolve as developers.
github and Kanban # Extra security with a good github setup, with no possibillity to push without making a pull request and review and approval from at least another member.
Always keeping track of schedule with Kanban & weekly meetings for reviewing the weeks work and planning ahead.
80%
JUnit Testing
Up to 80% test coverage.
title: Fog-Carport
